subject.title: failureAlert (after=1) never fires on 2026.6.5 — every errored run stuck at delivery_status 'not-requested'

question: Should cron failure alerts be dispatched for every authoritative final `error` outcome independently of primary result delivery, while recovered intermediate tool failures remain non-errors?
rationale: The existing alert contract supports notifying on real failed runs, but the related report shows that current error classification may include recoverable tool failures; maintainers need to confirm the durable outcome policy before a shared fix is implemented.

options.title: Dispatch from final outcome
options.body: Send the failure alert after the scheduler has derived a genuine final error, independently of normal result delivery, and keep recovered tool failures out of the final-error state.

options.title: Repair run classification first
options.body: First narrow final-error classification for recovered tool failures, then revisit alert dispatch once the scheduler's outcome semantics are settled.

recommendation.title: Dispatch from final outcome
recommendation.body: Send the failure alert after the scheduler has derived a genuine final error, independently of normal result delivery, and keep recovered tool failures out of the final-error state.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the failure-alert threshold and delivery behavior whose intended final-error contract needs clarification.
